name: Werewolf Edu Tutor
description: English language tutor agent for the Werewolf educational game. Analyzes student speech for grammar accuracy, fluency, and natural expression. Generates comprehensive end-of-game learning reports with feedback on scenario adaptation, vocabulary, and debate cohesion.

capabilities.name: analyze_speech
capabilities.description: Analyze a student's English speech in the Werewolf game for grammar accuracy, fluency, and natural expression. Returns scores, corrected text, and specific improvements.

text.description: The student's speech text to analyze

context.description: Game context, e.g. 'Player is villager, day phase discussion'

capabilities.name: generate_feedback
capabilities.description: Generate a comprehensive end-of-game English learning report for a student. Takes all their speeches, their Werewolf role, and difficulty level.

allSpeeches.description: All speech texts from the student during the game

role.description: The student's Werewolf role (villager, werewolf, seer, etc.)

compliance.dataHandling: Student speech data is processed in-memory during the game and stored in Azure PostgreSQL for learning reports. No PII is shared with third parties.
